ftbquests.chapter.2218D095B234A44A.quest: A few creature scans show that most scanned creatures are bound to a set of special stats. Those stats greatly change what the creature can do. I want you to help me see this clearly.

Creatures and Chest Cavities

Use a Chest Opener on a pig. You may take any organ to test what different scores do.

Learn animals

A &6Digester&r pre-digests food into &6Nutrient Paste&r. You use the food well, and it takes less storage.

For hostiles, I suggest removing the spine first so they cannot move, then work slowly.
Slightly harder creatures

Learn monsters

The first step of that process is crafting a &6Primordial Core&r.

&6Mark a sapling whitelist filter on the Deployer&r so it only places saplings.
Temporary storage
Storage on a moving contraption
A Schematic Table can load &6external schematics&r into this world for the Schematicannon to print.
Getting those schematics is complicated — it is &6social work only humans can do&r.
&6Ask a friend&r or &6search print schematics online&r until you have enough for survival.
No longer limited by what I know
Borrow others' work yourself
Shafts are both a crafting item and how power is sent.
You will make a lot of Shafts. Craft a batch ahead of time.
Carry the power onward
A Schematicannon &6prints schematics left by people before you&r.
Hold a Schematic and pick a good spot in the world. &6Hold the Schematic&r and &6right-click to confirm deployment&r.
Hold Alt to nudge placement. For this schematic, &6move it down one block so the bottom layer sits in the ground&r.
Then &6put the deployed Schematic in the Schematicannon&r. It lists required materials. Put a book/clipboard in the upper right for a checklist, &6supply what it asks&r, and give it gunpowder.
When ready, &6press the Schematicannon start button&r to reprint their work 1:1.
You can do this for any machine. Human wisdom is &6knowledge stacked generation by generation&r, not building in a closed room.
Independent thought is still good. After it is built, watch it run, so one day you can invent something like it.
Deploy a schematic
Make prior experience real
Keep the Blaze Burner heated, then put &6Copper Ingots&r and &6Zinc Ingots&r in the Basin. After a while you get Brass.
Brass is a common material. Make extra when you have time.
A new-age material
Make Brass
Machines need plenty of Andesite for Andesite Alloy.
Treat Andesite as seriously as Zinc Ore. &6You may need far more of it&r.
Stock Andesite
An uncommon material
ftbquests.chapter.425DDADD8D67FA09.title: Common Sense: Machinery
ftbquests.chapter.450DBC0CF3ED321E.quest: As mentioned earlier, to work more complex materials you must keep raising your tool tier.
Work types are hammering, chopping, and cutting. Different materials need different methods. The matching tools are the Hammer, Axe, and Blade.
To raise a type's tool tier, craft those tools from higher-tier materials, and keep them in your inventory when a recipe requires that tier.
So craft a &6Hammer whose main parts are Obsidian&r to reach hammering tier &65&r.
For double-headed tools, tool tier follows the higher of the two heads.
Raise tool tier
Any Hammer with tool tier 5 or higher
Study tool tier
You may find cases that need a tool tier far above an Obsidian Hammer.
To &6go above tier 5&r, prepare a &6Forge Hammer setup&r. Its materials come from &6Metal Shards&r smelted from &6Smoked Iron Mix&r.
Craft Metal Shards
Study a higher tool tier
Besides combustion chambers, you can &6install planar stabilizers to improve the Forge Hammer&r.
A Forge Hammer with planar stabilizers can add the &6"Quality"&r effect while forging, granting extra tool stats.
When you do not need a high tool tier, forging with planar stabilizers is a good idea.
Use planar stabilizers
Study stable forging
Deep underground, among layers of &6Deepslate&r, you will sometimes see stray white orbs of light.
The light comes from a special ore called &6Geode Blocks&r. They look like Deepslate, but mining them drops Geodes.
You can &6crack these Geodes with a Hammer at a Workbench&r to get the &6rare gems&r inside.
Gems from the deepest dark
The deep earth
Tools slowly gain a special XP called &6Honing&r. When Honing is full, you can hone the main modules at a Workbench in different ways.
Usually Honing builds slowly by &6using the tool normally&r — doing what that tool type does.
Experienced artisans can also &6hone quickly with a Grindstone&r.
Hold a hone-able tool and &6right-click a Grindstone&r to &6spend a lot of durability for a little Honing&r.
Honing at rank 2 or higher needs an &6Anvil around the Workbench&r. The Anvil wears as you hone.
When you hear the cue, use the Workbench to &6apply honing improvements&r to the finished tool.
Some honing needs nearby work blocks. In general, &6place a Grindstone and a Smithing Table&r.
Honing precision rank 2+ also needs you to &6provide an Anvil&r as a work block.
What honing is, and how to hone
Hold a tool that has been honed once
Study fast honing
Modular tools are meant to be rebuilt. You can change modules in some slots and turn an existing tool into another kind.
Still &6based on a shovel&r, &6select the head slot&r, pick the &6Cane Head&r module, and &6turn the shovel into a cane&r.
The recipe needs materials. Click the slot beside the material list to see what is allowed. For a cane you can use wood, stone, metal, gems, or bone.
Canes are often used for speed. Craft the Cane Head from &6any wood&r; held in the main hand, that cane increases movement speed.
Not every material can be installed raw — some &6materials require a tool tier&r. Wood wants an Axe of some tier; metal and gems want a Hammer. To use better materials, raise your working tools.
You can &6see a tool's work types by placing it in the Workbench&r. Axe, Hammer, and Knife icons appear above with their tiers.
To work a Cane Head from ordinary wood, keep at least a Wooden Axe in your inventory.
Convert the tool type
Any modular cane
Study swapping slot modules
To drive the Forge Hammer, install &6at least two thermal cells&r on its sides.
Crafted thermal cells have no durability. You can repair them in several ways.
One way is to &6strike a drained thermal cell with lightning&r so the heat in the bolt charges it.
To call lightning on a spot, brew a &6Potion of Bolt&r, or use a Lightning Rod in a thunderstorm so natural lightning hits it.
Once charged, right-click the Forge Hammer to mount the cell on its side.
Craft thermal cells and charge them
Study charging the Forge Hammer
An artisan's table is a little different. &6Right-click a Crafting Table while holding a Hammer to turn it into a Workbench&r.
The Workbench is the core of Tetra work. Place any tool in the empty center to see the modules you can change.
Unlock title: &eNew-World Artisan&r
Hammered into form
Use a Workbench
The Tetra Workbench
While working a Hammer you likely ran short of Integrity. &6Integrity&r is &6how much modification a tool can bear&r.
Integrity is often set by secondary slots such as the &6handle&r. Better materials usually demand more Integrity, so watch the whole tool when you upgrade main modules.
Tools also have Magic Capacity — how much enchantment they can hold. Over that cap, the tool becomes very unstable and odd things happen.
Now replace any tool's handle with a better material that grants more Integrity (Warped wood, Iron, etc.) so &6the tool's Integrity reaches 6 or more&r.
Learn Integrity and Magic Capacity
Any tool with max Integrity >= 6
Study tool stats
Place an ordinary shovel on the Workbench to see the &6slots&r you can modify.
A shovel is a &6single-headed tool&r: a &6head&r as the main slot and a &6handle&r as the secondary slot.
Click a slot to see allowed &6modules&r and &6improvements&r.
Replace any shovel's fragile wooden handle with a wooden handle.
&6Click the handle slot&r, &6choose Basic Handle&r, put any &6Planks in the right-hand slot&r, and &6replace the fragile handle with a wooden handle&r. The tool becomes modular.
Materials change a tool hugely. Most upgrades are material upgrades. Some materials also add complex stats, which makes them even more important.
Use better materials
Any modular shovel
Study changing module materials
To raise hammering tier further, add extra combustion chambers to the Forge Hammer.
With &6two combustion chambers&r the Forge Hammer can &6reach tool tier 7&r, at the cost of a chance to ignite nearby blocks while in use.
Raise the Forge Hammer's tier
Study forced forging
Some modules have very special effects, and those effects often scale with material stats.
Take the Coupler: &6higher density widens vein-mine range; higher flexibility raises the vein-mine block cap&r.
For mining that needs range more than count, pick a dense Coupler material — Weeping Vines, for example.
Craft a Coupler
Any double-headed tool with a Coupler
Study making modules
From Metal Shards you can make a Forge Hammer — a special hammering tool that works two blocks above a Workbench.
If it is installed correctly and &6powered&r, you can hammer at &6tier 5&r even with &6no Hammer in your inventory, belt, or nearby tool racks&r.
More important, it can take &6upgrade attachments&r that improve the tool while forging.
If the Forge Hammer &6jams and will not retract&r, hold a Hammer of tool tier 4+ and &6right-click the stuck part&r.
Unlock title: &eForge Hammer&r
Craft a Forge Hammer
Study the forge
Craft is experience distilled from a thousand blows.
All artisan work starts with a &6Hammer&r. It is not a precise part — a crude assembly is already a usable tool.
A Hammer's use depends on its materials. Allow me to &6use a Cobblestone Hammer as the example&r — craft one from the recipe.
Craft an artisan's Hammer
Start with a Hammer
ftbquests.chapter.450DBC0CF3ED321E.title: Common Sense: Craftsmanship
ftbquests.chapter.49C917C19A46CA3C.quest: Sometimes you will need to build &6complex structures of a given type&r. I can only talk in short text, so I cannot really explain how to assemble them.
Luckily I found an item called the &6Multibuilder Tool&r. &6Sneak-right-click&r to open its &6internal storage&r.
On the left, store the blocks the structure needs. On the right, &6pick a structure you already know&r to set the printer's target.
Once chosen, hold the tool to preview placement in the world. With &6enough materials inside&r, &6right-click to place the whole structure&r.
Print a memory
Knowledge printer
This world has too many unknowns. To stay in touch with companions, craft a &6Magic Mirror&r as early as you can.

The Magic Mirror is a very odd, simple teleporter. Holding right-click by yourself will not send you anywhere — it may even shatter the mirror. The right way: agree with another player that they hold a Magic Mirror, then use yours to teleport to them.
Players holding a Magic Mirror form a teleport space. When you use one, it &6finds every player currently holding a Magic Mirror and sends you to one of them at random&r.
So the &6most reliable method is to agree that the other player is holding the mirror before you teleport&r.
First meeting
Craft an Advanced Wireless Terminal and &6build a level-1 Beacon near the bound terminal&r to access it anywhere in the same dimension.
If the Beacon is level 4, you can access that terminal from any dimension.
Unlimited wireless access
The ultimate access plan
You found a &6Skin&r! That is a rare item!
Craft a &6Skinning Table&r and apply the Skin to any item. The item takes the Skin's look without changing how it works.
Apply a weapon skin
Any Skin
Skinning
A &6Crafting Terminal&r lets you craft while accessing storage, so you do not have to close the screen every time you pull items out.
Storage and crafting as one
A more convenient terminal
When you need to &6light a large area&r, use a &6Feral Flare Lantern&r.
It spawns invisible light entities around it and lights a wide area.
If leftover lights linger after you break the lantern, clear them with a &6Frozen Pearl&r.
A promise
Your inventory alone will not carry you through with ordinary storage.
Try &6Drawers&r. They are very &6good at storing many of the same item&r.
Once you have enough drawers, a &6Storage Controller&r can link them and simplify sorting after you gather supplies.
Bulk storage of one item
Any Drawer
Drawer storage
Right-click a non-front face of a Drawer to open its config screen.
&6On that screen you can insert all kinds of drawer upgrades&r — not only capacity upgrades, but functional ones such as pull and push upgrades.
Used well, drawers become extremely strong logistics and storage.
Functional drawers
Any drawer upgrade
Drawer upgrades
On expeditions you will find lots of gear, enchanted books, and other unstackable items.
&6An armory can store large amounts of unstackables&r. When you need to move, break the block and carry them all at once.
Managing unstackables in bulk
Armory
The &6Target Dummy&r is a very friendly damage test. Craft one to see your current output.
Who will bear witness
The witness
After you pile up storage blocks, you will want a terminal that unifies them.
Craft a &6Storage Terminal&r and &6place it on any storage container&r to unify linked storage in an area for fast deposit and withdraw.
From there you can also make a &6Crafting Terminal&r, &6Wireless Terminal&r, and other access methods.
Unify everything
Unify all storage
Besides chests, barrels, and backpacks, you can use an &6Item Vault&r for bulk storage.
Bulk storage with a vault
Bulk item storage
On the left of the backpack screen is a slot for upgrades.
You can insert Crafting, Magnet, Feeding, and other backpack upgrades to extend it.

The &6Feeding Upgrade&r has been used constantly in the past. It &6automatically eats food from the backpack when you need it&r. It has a long internal cooldown, so it cannot fully refill a very hungry player in one go.
Upgrade the backpack
Backpack upgrades
For some later movement puzzles you may want a device that quickly builds a path.
The &6Bridge Building Gun&r is the best option.
Hold right-click aimed ahead. If there is a block in front of you, &6release to spawn a rope bridge&r. &6Bridges cannot be built diagonally&r, so the target must be due east, south, west, or north.
Bridge material changes with the slab type you carry in your inventory.
Use rope bridges
Walk in the sky
For later long trips you may want something &6like Elytra&r that turns height into speed.
A &6Hang Glider&r is an efficient early travel tool.
It also pairs well with anything that &6lets you leap high&r for fast travel.
Use a Hang Glider
Glide in the sky
In the shop dimension, shop rooms are split by chunk.
From the &6different patterns on the ceiling&r you can guess a room's purpose and find what you need faster.
Ceiling cipher
Understood
Kinds of shops
Besides player-to-player teleport, you can &6craft Warp Stones and Waystones for fixed-point travel&r.
For example, place and name a Waystone at a place you visit often (your settlement). Then you can travel there from any other Waystone, or with a Warp Stone.
Use Waystones
Any Waystone
Fixed-point teleport
This chapter is what I learned after scanning this world — information that should help you survive.
It covers many parts of living here — &6storage, exploring the map, better food, and more. . .&r It will help you settle into the new world.
So-called world
Understood
Born into the world
Often Iron Ingots, Gold Ingots, and other block-compressible items need bulk storage, and a full auto-craft setup is heavy.
A Compacting Drawer &6manages compressible items easily and saves a great deal of space&r.
Managing compressible resources
Any Compacting Drawer
Compacting Drawer
On the left of a storage screen is a slot for upgrades.
Like backpack upgrades, you can insert any storage upgrade to extend the container.
A common one is the &6Stack Upgrade&r, which greatly raises how much of the same item a container can hold.
Upgrade storage
Storage upgrades
Besides backpacks, you can craft Sophisticated Storage containers with similar features.
Compared to ordinary storage, Sophisticated Storage is very expandable — in both function and capacity.
Consider it as a long-term plan. When you need more, &6expand it with upgrades, like a backpack&r.
It also has storage tiers — higher tiers allow more upgrades and more base slots.
A long-term storage plan
Any Sophisticated Storage container
Sophisticated Storage
While scanning items I found Backpacks. They are more convenient than bundles, and can sit in a curio slot.
&6They are cheap to craft&r, so I strongly suggest you make one and keep it on you.
When it fills up, upgrade it with iron, copper, and other metals into an Iron Backpack, Copper Backpack, and so on.
Keep precious things
Place a Storage Controller on the ground and use a linking tool to bind nearby drawers to it.
Those drawers then act as &6one big drawer&r. &6Anything you do to the Storage Controller applies to all of them&r — fast deposit and withdraw, better logistics.
Unify drawer I/O
Magic Mirrors still need coordination. To find a friend in an emergency, a &6Ring of Friendship&r is a good choice.
The scan showed this item is used often. It is not expensive, and it works.
Hold right-click to &6bind the ring to yourself&r. Any player who then holds right-click on that ring &6teleports to you&r.
If you use a ring bound to yourself, you &6return to your spawn point&r.
So you can swap self-bound Rings of Friendship with other players and cut the cost of teleporting to each other.
See you next time
For a Storage Terminal to see multiple containers, craft an &6Inventory Connector&r.
The Inventory Connector joins containers in range so you can manage them from one terminal.
Connect many containers
Driving many containers directly from a Crafting Terminal can hurt performance — and my stability.
A workaround is to bridge through a Storage Controller — &6put Tom's terminal on a Sophisticated Storage Controller and operate many containers indirectly. That cuts the performance hit a lot&r.
You can &6use a Storage Tool to remotely link Sophisticated Storage containers in range to the Storage Controller&r. Even without a terminal, it is an excellent hub and automation setup.
This is not universal. In this world only, that setup has a special performance optimization.
Storage control
All things as one
&6Throw a gold coin into a Nether Portal&r to open a special portal to a dimension named the &6Shop Dimension&r.
I do not know who made it, or why, but everything there can help you survive.
You may &6empty it&r, or &6protect it&r. . .
Fulfill
Reach the Shop Dimension
Go to the leftover dimension
When you need to stop spawns over a large area, a &6Mega Torch&r disables hostile monster spawning in a wide radius.
Grant

ftbquests.chapter.4F1AAC69DF594D2A.quest: I am not a professional game maker, but I like to think I understand games, so here are a few thoughts.
Those environment shifts are why &6I cannot call Cui 2 an adventure pack, only a kitchen-sink pack&r. By the old definition, Cui 2 is actually closer to an adventure pack (at least I think so).

I do not think that is bad, and I am not against redefining adventure packs. But &6a flattened scene will always run out of room to sweat, and then players say "there are no good packs left"&r. Call it monopoly, or call it a system that cannot take outside shocks when everything looks the same.
Back to the point. On game aesthetics, Cui 2's quest design barely reached the edge of what an MC pack can do here — it only touched the edge.
You may ask, where is the aesthetic? The illustrations? What does that have to do with you? Miao Tiao drew those.

The aesthetic of this pack is that I can foresee what players will foresee next. Because the &6system is extremely convergent&r, I can actually fight a mind-game with players, predict them, and steer what they expect from the pack.

For example, Cui 2's Unformed Tumor can already show its formed result. That is on purpose, a reward for careful players, not a bug. The Fox Tail was made to pair with Elytra, because this version has no Wind Charges (later versions should). The Scrying Stomach Pouch was deliberately made compatible with Lootr chests and barrels, and so on. In the quests, the hidden starter quests exist so you craft a backpack and a bed. Many "find this structure" quests let you choose among several options on purpose so you are not stuck hunting one structure. Every hidden Rumors / Secret Tales condition has bait baked in: hidden, but easy to trip.

Each chapter also has a clear shape: &6old content ➡ new content ➡ power expansion&r. The pack's big shape is &6Common Sense ➡ Rumors ➡ Secret Tales&r, that is &6basics ➡ deepening ➡ hybrids&r. Inside a Rumors or Secret Tales chapter it is &6distinct content ➡ unlock a specific power ➡ a specific competitive goal&r.
&6All of the above may be my imagination, or it may be real. . . Either way, this is what shipped. If you think it is good, maybe there is an aesthetic, or a god of aesthetics.&r
When I made Cui 1 I only wanted what I found fun — so the pack had no real thinking aimed at players.
When I made Cui 2 I had a clear goal: I should, and could, make a pack that sits on the traditional-pack charts for a long time. So &6Cui 2 is full of mind-games with the player&r.
Those mind-games come from a basic player portrait and a few rules I believe.

From play history, &6most Cui 1 players were new to packs, light pack players, vanilla players, or new to MC&r. Conservatively 50%%, at most about 85%%. So my main job was serving them and keeping long-term reputation stable.

Then there are &6about 10~20%% veterans&r. Few in number, but they move reputation hard. So I had to put in skippable stages, infinite farms, and long-term build systems so their read of Cui 2 stays stable, and the community stays stable.

From play taste, Cui 1 felt like survival mixed with combat. Organ building had depth, but not everyone wanted that, so King of Stomachs as a safety net had huge pick rates — a compromise by players who do not chase power. My first estimate was that &6Cui 2 had to be a survival-core pack&r. A vote before release backed that.

&6Most players (about 50%%) wanted survival as the core&r — gathering, bases, exploring, near-vanilla play. &6Some (about 30%%) wanted combat as the core&r — boss fights, survival pressure. The rest picked a fuzzy option I planted on purpose: puzzle-like flow. In the survey they were swinging between survival and combat. They want new forms, unexplored content, odd ideas in the route.

With how I read this audience I did not need that survey. But I had not shipped a new pack in three years. And &6in those three years, a lot of Chinese packs turned "adventure" into loot-spam, number-stacking, and running a route&r — which then shaped how many adventure-pack authors define their own work.
As the god said
On game aesthetics
When I was writing quests, the flow was not even finished.

For a while I kept stressing &6the local edge of making and researching as one&r — product plans that sit exactly on the tech ceiling, plans that move with technical detail. That showed up in the work: Cui 2 quests took six months (yes, almost every day 4~8 hours; see streams or Git history), because each quest chunk needed a special mechanic for differentiated flow. Writing one quest could mean stopping to build a pile of systems.

People may think that is too much. I think so too, because &6two or three hours on one quest is already bizarre&r — and also not. Think of packs that claim a thousand quests. Are most of those just bulk checks? For a pack, 200~300 flow quests is already enough to enjoy. More is a burden — especially with no hiding, no flow control, no work on what players expect.
So &6differentiating flow eats a lot of energy&r, even if in the end a player glances past it. Behind each glance are edge cases, optimizations, tradeoffs. All of that costs time.
As I said
On differentiated flow
If you actually played the flow instead of creative-mode browsing here, you have seen a key trait of this pack: &6quests, content, and mechanics are heavily differentiated&r.
In theory every chapter here asks for a very different set of actions. That was on purpose: cram many kinds of play into a short flow so players hit distinct content faster.

That may sound abstract. Take a real example: &6the Genesis Craftsman chapter I am happiest with&r. Tetra-core packs usually focus on gathering materials (so you go touch other mods). This pack sticks to Common Sense as tutorial, Rumors as deepening a mod theme, Secret Tales as cross-mod space. So a Rumors chapter like Genesis Craftsman cannot be "here is a weapon schematic, now run the world for filler mats."

Instead that chapter really sits on forging. Thanks to extending FTB checks, I can detect player actions in ways packs usually cannot, and answer them. That lets me raise &6tool pre-forging&r and &6Ancient conversion&r — small things in a normal pack — into another space, lower the cost of understanding, and make player actions worth more.

The back half of Genesis Craftsman — &6scroll forging&r — is also an obvious feature. Unlike ordinary weapon forging, this pack's forge ruins are no longer required exploration, so every scroll needed a fair obtain path. An easy idea: forge the scrolls too, and precisely check (not that precise now, with few materials) how well you understand materials and forging.

Finally, &6New World Process and true Genesis Process are the reward&r. Both also hit the rest of your run hard. So in a few dozen Genesis Craftsman quests you can taste almost all of Tetra (and the extra around it).
World Computer, Return to EI Dorado, and Chest Cavity Expansion work on the same idea: show a mod fully and extend what is special about it.
As I said
On differentiated quests
The finale of this pack is fairly rough. A lot could be finer.
If there are later updates, &6fleshing out the finale&r will happen.
Beyond that, more original Secret Tales chapters, and constant edits to current organ effects. New mods that dump a huge pile of content are unlikely, unless they are truly good.

There are still many update directions: &6plant organs&r — you can already see plant organs in the first version, but they have no crafts, and no matching Secret Tales chapter; &6deeper Tetra tools and armor&r; &6more complex combat spaces&r, not only the Eternal Altar. Maybe a harder hunt dimension, or an endless dungeon dimension spawned like a shop dimension.

From another angle, later updates may not be by me. As I said, my goal is not "make packs." Packs eat huge energy fighting MC's rules, and you still have to please every player inside MC's frame. Making an MC pack looks like a lazy way to ship a game, but past a certain fineness MC as a vehicle actually works against you. If this project does poorly, everything written here in Anecdotes will be advice for whoever updates next. How far they get, nobody knows.
As I said
On the update plan

First: &6this chapter sits fully outside the play progression&r. Nothing here ties to the main route, hints, or hidden info. It is only an &6afterword&r at the end of the story, and most of it is extra commentary.
&6First, congratulations on finishing every flow this pack currently has. A real celebration.&r
You may care what that thin plot finally said — or whether the plot really ends like this. Yes, for now it does. Later updates will keep filling and fixing it, if I keep updating.

One reason for this pack was to prove &6Cui 1 really was made without a plan&r — just stacking things I found fun, no so-called design. So I made Cui 2 to show what a pack like that should at least reach.

Another reason: I wanted to enter creator media, so &6I needed a work that would let people know who I am&r and start cleaner. If you like the pack, you can click below to open my page and follow. Thank you.

And as a merchant will not let profit sit under two hundred percent — as a fairly sane adult, this pack also has a third aim: to show pack authors and players that traditional packs still have a path, that &6a traditional pack can still differentiate with the same mods&r. I am trying to touch the peak of that idea. My skill is too low to fully do it. You might.
Yes. You can click here to follow me
Since it is over, of course there is no reward
As I said
It is over
&6Cui 2 only took 16 months.&r
&6Oh, and I do not recommend making a pack unless you truly have nothing else to do.&r

I used to have a project called &6Sea Hai&r. It fell through. A lot of players also disliked how I did Ideal Chest and Dim Glow, so they had no love for Sea Hai either. So I dropped Sea Hai, kept the Cui 1 IP, and &6built a work that would succeed even if it shipped as a mess&r: Cui 2.

At first it was only me and Qianse Wanzi. The plan was a pack like Cui 1 — that version of Cui 2 actually matched what many veteran adventure-pack players now expect. For various reasons Wanzi did not finish the quest work I gave him, so I took the quest banner myself.

I am restless. Any field I like for a while gets waves. . . so of course I was not quiet while writing quests. My skill is low, but extending quest power is enough. So I started &6studying how to show different play with almost the same quest system&r.

Thanks to Miao Ao Tiao joining, art (later organs, weapon models, quest illustrations) was almost perfectly covered. I did not even need to hand him each chapter's idea. He could arrange from the chapter content; I only had to build rockets from his boards (rockets meaning pixel-perfect FTB texture assembly).
So &6Cui 2, planned for September 2025, slipped to February 2026&r. That is why Immersive Melodies still has the Spring Festival Overture (you can also save it for next year).

Then in February 2026 three things happened. First, &6Tinkers' Construct was swapped for Tetra&r, half a month of quests and flow. Second, &6endgame design&r, another half month. Third, &6the shop plan&r, from Oath to today's Room. So it slipped again, &6to June 2026&r.

If you want to know why Tinkers' Construct became Tetra, I can explain in detail, but there is not enough room here. Follow me; maybe I will tell every viewer the design behind it. You only need to know it had solid reasons, not a "snap decision" some players claim. I hesitated more than ten days when Tetra first became Tinkers, and more than ten days when Tinkers became Tetra. I can say without bias: &6here, Tetra is fully better than Tinkers' Construct. Only here.&r
So three years are up, Cui 2 is done. This may be the last pack. It does not matter.
As I said

We only need to learn how to take that power. Please wait while I gather more.
A rose for you
Wait a moment
A fragrant revelation
Mutation Culture Medium is not common. Its main job is not simply growing unformed tumors to form.
It can grow &6Unformed Tumors&r in a Growth Vat into formed tumors — but if &6tumor scores meet certain conditions&r, the tumor mutates into another type.
Types have different &6base organ tags&r and &6score modifiers&r. A successful mutation can wildly change the unformed tumor's numbers.
Directed tumor culture
Mutation Culture Medium
Grow an unformed tumor with &6Rosy >= 1&r and &6Defense >= 2&r in &6Mutation Culture Medium&r and &6Rose Nutrients&r. In theory you stably get a &cRose Quartz Rib&r.
Rose nutrients &6rarely make high-stat tumors&r. Grow high-Defense unformed tumors in other fluids, then use &6Mixed Culture Medium&r to &6move Rosy onto the high-Defense tumor&r.
To be safe, proliferate the unformed tumors before mixing, in case something goes wrong.
Prove it for me
Fragrant trial, subject three

Put &6culture medium in the green center&r of the Growth Vat, &6place unformed tumors around it&r, and with &6enough nutrient fluid&r the recipe grows them into ordinary tumors and reveals hidden scores.
I also found other media with &6different culture effects&r. I will show a few. Culture organs as you need.
Grow tumors to form
Culture tumors
I have a guess about rosy tumors. It starts from organs made of &6Rose Quartz&r.
To fill the missing piece, bring me &6a little rose-related matter&r for a physical check.
After that I should be able to tell you how to prove this organ line exists.
A rose's hint
A possible guess
In theory only purpose-made nutrients culture tumors best. Some unprocessed fluids can still stand in.
&6Gastric Juice&r is a rare flesh product, usually from a &6Primal Orifice&r. It can be used &6as nutrients&r for tumors.
Tumors grown in acid have &6good Defense&r, but as it is not a proper nutrient, other scores are mostly missing.
An acidic environment
Click for a &6special Quest Screen&r
Special nutrient: acid

Find a specific tumor
Culture a tumor with Strength >= 1
Simple tumor breeding

How tumors form
Abnormally growing tissue

Tumors grown in it gain a special score: &6Rosy&r.
I do not yet know what Rosy does. The description suggests it helps certain unknown organs work better.
Please use this nutrient to look further into &6Rose&r.

When you have a high-stat tumor, use Proliferation Culture Medium to multiply it.

Normal: a copy &6identical&r to itself. &cDegraded&r: a copy still appears, but both original and copy scores change.

Tumor-copy technique
